name: Type the room, press Enter
bet: She keeps both hands on the keyboard: two letters of a room's name find it, and Enter books it.
cost: Nothing can be done without typing, and a room whose name she does not know cannot be found.
absent: Anything to point at, or to press with a finger
hardest: When nothing is free, typing a room's name shows when it frees up, and Enter books it from then.

screens.title: Today, at 9:40
screens.note: The typing cursor is in the field when the screen opens, and stays there.

items.text: 2 rooms free now: Room 2 until 10:30, Sala Jardín until 11:15

items.note: Two letters are enough. The arrow keys move between the rooms that match.

items.text: Press Enter to book the room for 30 minutes. Press Tab to change how long.
Press Ctrl+Z within two minutes to undo.
